refundConsent.title: Updated terms
refundConsent.disclosure: We have updated our terms to cover Apple refund reviews. By agreeing below, you accept the updated terms and allow Shelvr, through RevenueCat, to share purchase and delivery information with Apple when you request a refund. Apple makes the final decision. Your saved links, notes, and photos are not part of this.
refundConsent.optional: Sharing is optional. You can keep using Shelvr and request refunds without agreeing to share. You can change your choice in Profile.
refundConsent.error: Your choice could not be saved. Please try again.
refundConsent.enabled: You allow purchase and delivery information to be shared with Apple for refund reviews.
refundConsent.syncPending: Your choice is saved. Updating RevenueCat; the previous setting may apply until this finishes.
aiConsent.title: Shelvr titles and files your saves for you
aiConsent.body: It does this with Google's Gemini AI. Shelvr sends what you save to Google: link addresses and page text, your notes, your photos and your space names.
aiConsent.changeLater: You can change this anytime in Settings.
aiConsent.settingHelp: Sends what you save to Google's Gemini AI. Off: saves keep only the page's own title.
aiConsent.findLinksOff: Turn on AI in Settings to find links.
aiConsent.signInNote: Shelvr uses Google's Gemini AI to title and file your saves. Continuing allows this. You can turn it off in Settings.
